description.en: The default button, plus the secondary, outline and ghost variants.
description.zh: 默认按钮，以及次要、描边和幽灵三种变体。

description.en: Three sizes, a disabled button, a destructive action and a spinner composed as a child.
description.zh: 三种尺寸、禁用状态、危险操作，以及把 Spinner 作为子元素组合出的加载态。

title.zh: 图标、纯图标与链接按钮

description.en: Icons compose as children; icon-only buttons need an accessible name, and asChild keeps link semantics.
description.zh: 图标作为子元素组合；纯图标按钮必须提供无障碍名称，asChild 则保留链接语义。
